# The Prometheus Flesh-Guilds — Draft Datasheets

*Owned verb: **GRAFT** · generated by `unit_calculator.py faction` · ×1.5 scale · stat line = MOV · MS · RS · ARM · MIGHT · CTRL*

**Core trait — Organ & Scrap Harvest:** When any unit (friend or foe) is destroyed within 6″ of a Prometheus unit, gain 1 Graft (max 3 banked). When a unit activates, spend 1 Graft to give it ONE permanent upgrade for the rest of the battle: +1 PEN on one weapon · +1 to Hit with one weapon · heal D3 MIGHT and +1 MIGHT maximum (once). Each unit can take each upgrade once.

**Gamble — Over-Graft** *(risk: durability + resource)*: Spend 2 Grafts on one unit at once for two different upgrades, then roll a D6: on a 1 the unit suffers D3 Fatal Wounds and loses one of the new upgrades (your choice).

**Army-wide rules (priced into every unit):** *Graft: Edge* — Some units gain +1 PEN mid-battle. · *Graft: Optics* — Some units gain +1 to Hit mid-battle.

## Detachment — Surgeon-Cult

*Heal, rebuild and out-last.*

**Detachment rule:** Bloodied Instruments: Field Surgery and Master of Flesh-Grafting heal +1. Grafts may also be gained when a friendly unit loses its last model within 6″ of a Leader.

**Enhancements**
- **Bone-Saw of Prometheus** (+30 pts, Arch-Chirurgeon Prime): The attached unit has UNYIELDING 5+.
- **Reserve Organs** (+10 pts, Rust-Priest Chirurgeon): Field Surgery may be used twice per round.

**Stratagems**
- **Emergency Graft** (1 CP) — *A unit is destroyed:* Gain 2 Grafts instead of 1 (max 3).
- **Adrenal Shunt** (1 CP) — *A unit is selected to Fight:* +1 Attack; it suffers 1 Fatal Wound afterward.
- **Stitch Them Back** (2 CP) — *End of Round:* Return D3 slain models to a Class 1 unit within 6″ of a Leader.

## Detachment — Forge-Legion

*Cyborg infantry phalanxes that switch protocols each round.*

**Detachment rule:** Bionic Imperatives: Command Phase, choose for the army: Protector (+1 ARM against attacks from more than 12″; ranged weapons gain [HEAVY]) or Conqueror (ranged weapons gain [ASSAULT] and +1 PEN within 9″).

**Enhancements**
- **Command Uplink** (+15 pts, Signal-Augur): Friendly units within 9″ re-roll Hit rolls of 1.
- **Overclocked Servos** (+10 pts, Galvanic Phalanx): +2″ MOV.

**Stratagems**
- **Override Protocol** (1 CP) — *A unit activates:* Use the other Imperative for this unit this activation.
- **Binharic Volley** (1 CP) — *Two units target the same enemy:* The second gets +1 to Wound.
- **Machine Resolve** (1 CP) — *A unit would be Rattled:* It is not.

## Detachment — Galvanic Breach

*Lightning-coils and arc weapons: trade your own MIGHT for damage.*

**Detachment rule:** Lightning-Coil Overload: when a unit is selected to Shoot or Fight, it may suffer 1 Fatal Wound: its weapons gain [IMPALING HITS] this activation.

**Enhancements**
- **Capacitor Heart** (+10 pts, Graft-Knight Paragon): Melee critical hits on 5+ (auto-wound).
- **Storm-Coil Mantle** (+10 pts, Arch-Chirurgeon Prime): Units within 6″ ignore the Fatal Wound from Overload on a 4+.

**Stratagems**
- **Chain Lightning** (1 CP) — *An Overloaded attack destroys a unit:* Inflict D3 Fatal Wounds on another enemy unit within 6″.
- **Grounding Rods** (1 CP) — *A unit is hit by an [PSYCHIC / ARCANE] attack:* It gets WARD 5+ against that attack.
- **Discharge** (1 CP) — *A unit is charged:* The charging unit suffers D3 Fatal Wounds on a 4+.
